description: Change Locus settings by key, as listed by config_query. All changes in one call are validated and applied together; if one fails, none are kept. Changes take effect immediately unless config_query marks the setting as applying after restart. Project-scoped settings are written to the current project's Locus/config.json. Sensitive settings (debug logging, workspace file boundary, Unity non-public compile access, worktree root, Claude Code CLI) always ask the user to confirm. Only change settings the user asked for or clearly agreed to, and state the reason.

value.description: New value matching the setting's type: boolean, integer within range, one of the listed enum values, a path or text string, or an array of strings.

reason.description: Short reason shown to the user when the change needs confirmation.
